style: real top-down studio photograph, warm natural colour, plain white background
themeWhy: the three pictures are paper things (a card, a card, a sheet): kraft-tan keys in the paper family and a magenta-marker Enter as the joyful treat, clear of the chapter's sky blue, amber, deep blue, vermilion and green and never red or violet

images.object: blank birthday card, marigold-yellow card stock with a small balloon motif in the top right corner
images.why: Phase 1, Look 'a real card' and Stage 'a birthday card ... in its natural colours': the birthday card, drawn once as the card behind the event line, the written date and the three Day, Month, Year boxes (all drawn in code on its face; the face is plain and empty, keep text off the small balloon cluster in its top right corner). Made 458 by 300, a 1.53:1 card: draw it at that proportion (never stretched; a wider box crops its gold border and balloons). Shown from the phase's first frame, before any tap
images.prompt: A single wide landscape greeting card, nearly twice as wide as it is tall, of thick matte marigold-yellow card stock with softly rounded corners and a narrow deeper-gold printed border just inside its edge. The face is smooth, plain and empty except one small cluster of three glossy balloons in tangerine orange, caramel and cream, printed in the top right corner.

images.object: blank invitation card, soft peach card stock with a gold border
images.why: Phase 2, Look 'a real card' and Stage 'an invitation': the invitation card, drawn once as the card behind the event line, the written date and the three Day, Month, Year boxes (all drawn in code on its face; the whole face inside its narrow gold border is plain and empty). Made 514 by 300, a 1.71:1 card with a deckled edge: draw it at that proportion (never stretched). Shown from the phase's first frame, before any tap
images.prompt: A single wide landscape invitation card, nearly twice as wide as it is tall, of thick matte soft-peach card stock with softly rounded corners, a gently deckled edge and a narrow metallic-gold border just inside the edge. The whole face is smooth, plain and empty.

images.object: blank school notice sheet, light manila-tan paper with a brass drawing pin
images.why: Phase 3, Look 'a real card' and Stage 'a school notice': the loose notice sheet, drawn once as the paper behind the event line, the written date and the three Day, Month, Year boxes (all drawn in code on its face; keep text off the brass drawing pin at the middle of its top edge). The same sheet serves the words-to-numbers questions of this phase; no diary page is made. Made 540 by 300, a 1.80:1 sheet: draw it at that proportion (never stretched). Shown from the phase's first frame, before any tap
images.prompt: A single loose sheet of light manila-tan paper, a wide landscape rectangle nearly twice as wide as it is tall, matte with a fine paper grain and slightly irregular real edges, with one polished brass drawing pin through the middle of its top edge. The sheet is otherwise smooth, plain and empty.
